items.summary_en: God's Eye View is an open source browser app that renders a photorealistic 3D globe layered with live aircraft, ships, satellite, earthquake, traffic and public camera data, plus hands-free voice control driven by a realtime AI agent. Built by bilawalsidhu, the developer behind the YouTube series of the same name (formerly WorldView), it reached #1 on GitHub Trending. It suits developers working on geospatial visualization and real-time data feeds.

items.summary_zh: 文章作者回顾了从 2025 年 4 月到 2026 年 4 月使用 Cursor 的经历，称赞 Tab 补全、Agent 等编辑器内体验，还提到 2026 年 2 月零代码做出过功能完整的微信小程序。当 Cursor 改为按量计费、费用不可预测后，公司决定中国区换用 OpenAI Codex，文章分享的是转用 Codex 大半个月的真实感受。
items.summary_en: The author looks back on a year with Cursor, praising its in-editor Tab completion and Agent mode, and says he built a functional WeChat mini-program with zero hand-written code. After Cursor switched from fixed pricing to unpredictable usage-based billing in April 2026, his company moved its China region to OpenAI Codex; the article offers his impressions after about half a month with Codex.

items.summary_zh: AMD 于 9 月 10 日在北京发布锐龙 AI Max PRO 400 系列处理器，并联合星漪科技、首界科技、六联智能等展示 Mini PC、紧凑工作站、笔记本与 AI NAS 等终端产品。该平台最高配备 128GB 统一内存，其中最多 96GB 可划为显存，通过 CPU、GPU、NPU 异构算力把大模型、长上下文 RAG 和多智能体工作流放到本地运行，适合关注端侧智能体部署的开发者。
items.summary_en: AMD unveiled its Ryzen AI Max PRO 400 processors at a Beijing media event on September 10, alongside partners like Flowy and Nova showing Mini PCs, compact workstations, laptops and AI NAS built on the platform. The chip offers up to 128GB of unified memory, 96GB of which can be allocated as VRAM, letting local LLMs, long-context RAG and multi-agent workflows run across CPU, GPU and NPU. It targets developers weighing on-device agent deployment.

items.title: [分享发现] 半夜寂寞,买了个飞机杯,到手感觉亏大了，我日！拍断大腿！
items.summary_zh: 一位 V2EX 用户花两百多买了个飞机杯，商品页宣称自动吮吸、伸缩、加热，到手发现只是硅胶加廉价塑料做的伸缩结构，所谓加热是插 USB 后功率仅 2-3W 的小棒，体验极差，自认血亏。这类成人用品的宣传与实物落差极大，提示想下单的人先看清硬件参数，别为营销词买单。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user paid just over 200 yuan for a masturbation device advertised with automatic suction, thrusting and heating. What arrived was silicone plus a cheap plastic telescoping mechanism, with "heating" handled by a tiny USB rod drawing only 2-3W; he calls it a total waste of money. A cautionary note for anyone shopping in this category, where marketing copy rarely matches the hardware.

items.title: 当 AI 写出更多代码，企业为什么没有跑得更快？| JDD 大会现场观察
items.summary_zh: 京东 JDD 大会现场观察：9 月 9 日京东在北京亦庄发布京东 APP 16.0 与 AI 购物助手「东东」，同时京东零售产研团队指出，AI Coding 率上升并未带来整体研发效率的同步提升。他们把研发链路拆为「上工程」（需求定义、架构、跨团队协同）与「下工程」（Review、测试、发布运维），并引用麦肯锡 2026 调研：80% 受访者认可 AI 提升个人效率，仅 37% 认可其对企业 EBIT 的正向影响。
items.summary_en: A field report from JD.com's JDD conference: on September 9 in Beijing, JD unveiled JD APP 16.0 with an AI shopping assistant called Dongdong, while its retail R&D team raised an uncomfortable point — higher AI Coding rates haven't lifted overall R&D efficiency. They split the pipeline into "upstream engineering" (requirements, architecture, cross-team coordination) and "downstream engineering" (review, testing, release, ops), citing a 2026 McKinsey survey in which 80% said AI improved personal productivity but only 37% saw a positive impact on company EBIT.

The post contains only that prompt, with no further detail or conclusions; it is a discussion thread for developers with opinions on AI-assisted coding.

items.title: AI 有了“工号”，数据平台长出了手：我在 Snowflake World Tour 看到的三个变化
items.summary_zh: 作者在 Snowflake World Tour 上海站听完全球产品总裁 Christian Kleinerman 的 Keynote 后，总结出三个细节：Agent 开始拥有 Identity 与 Policy，能像员工一样被授予“工号”，限制它读写什么、调动哪些数据乃至预算；数据平台从被动查询转向主动执行；Snowflake 开始拥抱开源。文章面向关注 Agent 在企业落地的数据与 AI 从业者。
items.summary_en: Writing up Snowflake World Tour Shanghai, the author draws three takeaways from global product president Christian Kleinerman's keynote: agents now get Agent Identity and Policy, effectively an employee ID capping what they can read, write, move and spend; data platforms are starting to take action rather than just answer queries; and Snowflake is embracing open source. Aimed at data and AI practitioners tracking enterprise agent adoption.

items.title: AI Coding 的下一步不是写得更快，而是可验收：蚂蚁数科 Harness 工程实践
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁数科技术专家魏长征在 AICon 分享 Harness 工程实践：40 多万行的 Rust 新项目从第一天就把 Harness 内建进流程，60 多万行的 C++ 存量项目先重建事实源与质量门禁，再让 Agent 参与升级，缺陷率从 20% 以上降到个位数。他认为 AI Coding 的关键已不是写得快，而是可验收。
items.summary_en: At AICon, Ant Digital Technologies expert Wei Changzheng described a "Harness" engineering approach: a 400k-line Rust project had Harness built into its workflow from day one, while a 600k-line legacy C++ project first rebuilt its source of truth and quality gates before agents were allowed to upgrade the repo, cutting defect rates from over 20% to single digits. His argument: verifiability, not speed, is AI coding's next step.

items.title: 刘震云对话马毅：人写不出来、想不到的作品，AI 模仿不了｜附完整对话
items.summary_zh: 9 月 10 日 Inclusion·外滩大会的圆桌上，作家刘震云与香港大学计算与数据科学学院院长马毅讨论 AI 与人的边界。刘震云称网上 95% 以他形象出现的视频是假的，但 AI 模仿不了他尚未写出的作品；马毅认为大模型只掌握人类的共性、难懂个体个性，教育应教学生用 AI 放大自身能力。
items.summary_en: At a roundtable at the Inclusion Bund Conference in Shanghai on September 10, novelist Liu Zhenyun and Ma Yi, dean of HKU's School of Computing and Data Science, debated what stays uniquely human as AI advances. Liu said 95% of videos using his likeness are fake, yet AI cannot imitate works he hasn't written; Ma argued LLMs grasp only humanity's shared knowledge, not individual character, and that education should teach students to amplify their own skills with AI.

items.title: 一句话就能下单，商业入口要变了！蚂蚁 CEO 韩歆毅：未来竞争的不只是流量
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁集团 CEO 韩歆毅在 9 月 11 日上海外滩大会上表示，智能体商业的"ChatGPT 时刻"已经到来，智能体正从能力展示走向真实交易，AI 支付宝"阿宝"今年 6 月公测，用户一句话就能下单。蚂蚁 AI 支付总经理朱林预计，未来 5 年更自然的新交互支付占比或超 50%，智能设备支付将增长 10 倍。
items.summary_en: Ant Group CEO Han Xinyi told the Inclusion·Bund Conference in Shanghai on September 11 that agentic commerce has reached its "ChatGPT moment," with agents moving from capability demos to real transactions; Alipay's AI assistant "Abao" opened beta in June and lets users place orders with one sentence. Ant's AI payments head Zhu Lin expects natural new-interaction payments to top 50% within five years, with smart-device payments up tenfold.

items.title: 怒斥加密货币是旁氏骗局、放弃80%就业机会也不用 AI 写代码！Kotlin“J神”：AI 会让工程师变成可替换的齿轮
items.summary_zh: 被国内开发者称为“J 神”的 Android 与 Kotlin 开源开发者 Jake Wharton 列出九项择业标准，第一条即不加入 AI 公司、不参与以 AI 为核心的产品，他估算这一条排除了约 80% 的潜在雇主。他称自己至今没用 AI Agent 写代码，认为 AI 可以处理重复劳动，但让模型生成超出使用者能力范围的代码最不负责任。
items.summary_en: Jake Wharton, a well-known Android and Kotlin open source developer, has listed nine criteria for his next job, starting with a refusal to join AI companies, work on AI-centric products, or accept mandatory AI tooling — a rule he estimates rules out roughly 80% of employers. He says he has never used an AI agent to write code, arguing AI can handle repetitive work but that generating code beyond a developer's ability to understand and maintain is the most irresponsible use.

items.title: AI Coding 提速之后，如何补上稳定性“最后一公里”？快手柯南 AI 实践
items.summary_zh: 快手主站技术稳定性专家王泽锋在 AICon 上海站分享了“柯南 AI”的稳定性工程实践：确定性的流程交给代码，概率性的推理交给模型，用 Skill 沉淀专家经验并由 Bad Case 驱动系统进化。该系统在快手大前端研发的用户渗透率已接近 60%，根因分析结果的完整采纳率约 50%，曾在鸿蒙 C++ Crash 案例中约 10 分钟定位到纯系统堆栈的 Use-After-Free 问题。
items.summary_en: Wang Zefeng, a stability engineer at Kuaishou, presented the company's 'Conan AI' work at AICon Shanghai: deterministic steps go to code, probabilistic reasoning to models, with expert experience captured as Skills and bad cases driving iteration. The system has reached nearly 60% adoption among Kuaishou's front-end R&D staff, with about 50% full adoption of its root-cause analyses, and located a pure system-stack Use-After-Free issue behind a HarmonyOS C++ crash in roughly 10 minutes.

items.title: [程序员] 记录一下最近 2 个月做 Ozon 工具和一次未开始就散掉的合作
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者记录了自己近两个月帮朋友做 Ozon 精铺上架工具的经历：他花一周用 AI 把一个需手动安装、自配 Key 的 Chrome 扩展的生图逻辑改成异步任务队列，抹平了频繁超时报错；到襄阳实地看业务后，他判断本地插件是保姆式服务、应转做 SaaS 网页版，但三人最终因套餐定价和 token 单价谈不拢，系统上线前合作就散了。
items.summary_en: A developer recounts two months spent helping a friend build a listing tool for Ozon, the Russian cross-border marketplace: he used AI to turn a Chrome extension's image-generation flow into an async task queue within about a week, eliminating constant timeouts. After visiting the team in Xiangyang to see the business firsthand, he concluded the local-plugin model was unsustainable hand-holding and pushed for a SaaS version, but the three partners split over subscription and token pricing before launch.

items.summary_en: Brosis is a menu-bar activity recorder for macOS 26+ on Apple Silicon that turns what you read, write, and use on screen into a searchable timeline, handed to AI agents over MCP. items.summary_en: RED is an open-source Skill plus CLI built around three stages — Research, Evolve, and Document — that keeps an AI informed across a project's whole lifecycle, from clarifying requirements to recording accepted decisions for later rounds. It installs via `npx @exoticknight/red` and is aimed at teams that want AI to support long-running iteration rather than one-off code generation.

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）近期热度上升，插件生态迅速扩张，文章筛选了 15 款值得安装的插件。适合正在使用 DSH、想扩展工作流的开发者快速参考。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is gaining traction and its plugin ecosystem is expanding rapidly; this article highlights 15 plugins worth installing. Developers already using DSH and wanting to extend their workflow should find it a useful starting point.

items.title: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩
items.description: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩？工程化解法详解 前言 你有没有试过用ChatGPT写小说？ 前几章写得挺好，角色鲜明、情节紧凑。但写到30章左右，突然发现：主角的妹妹名字变了，第5章埋的伏笔忘了回收，
items.summary_zh: 文章用 ChatGPT 写长篇示例：开头角色鲜明、情节紧凑，但约 30 章后会出现主角妹妹名字变化、第 5 章伏笔未回收等一致性崩溃；它分析了这类长文崩坏的工程原因，并给出工程化解决思路。适合用大模型做长篇创作的开发者和写作者。
items.summary_en: The post uses a ChatGPT novel as an example: early chapters are vivid and tight, but around chapter 30 continuity collapses—a heroine's sister changes name and a setup from chapter 5 is forgotten. It then explains why this failure happens in long-form AI writing and outlines an engineering-oriented fix, making it relevant for developers and authors producing long texts with LLMs.

items.title: 这个本地模型，让我 token 自由了
items.description: Qwen3.8-27B 把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬进个人电脑，本地运行不花 API 费用，但速度、内存和长任务体验仍有明显门槛。
items.summary_zh: 掘金这篇文章讲的是 Qwen3.8-27B，一个能跑在个人电脑上、不花 API 费用的本地模型，主打把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬到本机。作者也点明代价：速度、内存占用和长任务体验仍有明显门槛，适合愿意折腾本地推理、对响应速度不那么敏感的人。
items.summary_en: The post looks at Qwen3.8-27B, a local model that brings flagship-level agent capability to a personal machine without paying API fees. The author is upfront about the trade-offs: inference speed, memory footprint and long-task experience remain real barriers. It suits developers willing to run local inference who can live with slower responses.

items.description: 最近火了一个电影哈！ 可以说是拳打《蜘蛛侠》，脚踢《龙餐馆》，没错就是这个“土到极致就是潮”的“巨制”——《牛来》 我简单看了一下背景，这个电影据传就俩人的主创...
items.summary_zh: 文章用 Three.js 实现了一个简易版电影《牛来》的效果，并附上完整代码和演示效果。作者提到这部据传仅两人主创的电影因“土到极致就是潮”而走红；适合想借热点练习 Three.js 动画的开发者。
items.summary_en: This post builds a simplified Three.js version of the viral Chinese movie Niu Lai, with the full source code and a demo. The author notes the film is reportedly created by just two people and became popular for its proudly cheesy aesthetics. It's a good starting point for developers learning Three.js through a trending cultural reference.

items.title: 为什么跳槽涨薪 30% 的时代彻底结束了？聊聊 2026 前端薪资的天花板
items.description: 前端薪资红利期结束，供需失衡与AI工具普及压缩执行层价值。高薪转向决策层，需具备成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力。
items.summary_zh: 文章称，前端跳槽涨薪 30% 的红利期已结束，2026 年薪资天花板受到人才供需失衡和 AI 工具普及的双重挤压，执行层价值被压低。高薪机会转向决策层，需要能承担成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力的工程师。适合想评估前端职业空间和技术栈方向的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: The article argues that the era of 30 percent pay raises from job-hopping is over for front-end developers; by 2026 the salary ceiling is squeezed by supply-demand imbalance and AI tools that devalue execution-focused work. Higher-paying roles now go to decision-level engineers who can handle cost optimization, standards, or full-stack work. Good context for developers mapping their front-end career options.

items.summary_zh: 前端开发者“小张同学”结合近期每天用 AI 写代码的体验，分享了一套 AI 全栈开发实践，并坦言手写代码能力已经明显下降。他认为按当前节奏，AI 编写代码会在更多场景替代人工。适合正在搭建 AI 辅助编程流程的开发者参考，也提醒自己别丢掉基本功。
items.summary_en: A front-end developer who goes by “小张同学” shares full-stack development practices built around writing code with AI every day. He admits his hand-coding ability has dropped noticeably and argues AI-generated code will keep replacing manual work in more scenarios. The post is useful for developers building AI-assisted workflows and doubles as a warning about foundational-skills atrophy.
